en.headline: AFCD finds three cases of large dogs without proper leashes in special operation
en.dek: The three-day enforcement action across dog-gathering spots ended on Sunday; the department will prosecute the keepers under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said a three-day special enforcement operation on proper control of dogs in public places found three cases in which large dogs were not kept on a leash of no more than two metres.

The operation took place on 30 August and on 5 and 6 September at locations where dogs commonly gather. Officers will follow up and prosecute the keepers concerned. The department said the action aimed to raise awareness among dog keepers, reduce the risk of attacks caused by inadequate control, and promote responsible pet ownership.

Under the Rabies Ordinance, dogs in public places must be kept on a leash or under other effective control. The Dangerous Dogs Regulation further requires that large dogs weighing 20 kg or more must be held on a leash not exceeding two metres. Contravention can result in a fine and imprisonment.

zh.headline: 漁護署特別執法發現三宗大型狗隻未牽繩個案將檢控
zh.dek: 三日巡查於公眾地方狗隻聚集點進行，署方將跟進檢控涉事畜養人，提醒大型狗隻須用不多於兩米狗帶牽引。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，為期三日的妥善控制狗隻特別巡查及執法行動，共發現三宗涉嫌在公眾地方未以不多於兩米狗帶牽引大型狗隻的個案，署方將跟進及提出檢控。
行動於8月30日、9月5日及6日在全港多個狗隻聚集地點進行。署方指，行動旨在提升畜養人於公眾地方妥善控制狗隻的意識，減少因控制不足而引致的襲擊意外，並推廣負責任寵物主人訊息。
根據《狂犬病條例》，狗隻在公眾地方必須以狗帶牽引或以其他有效方式控制。《危險狗隻規例》進一步規定，體重達20公斤或以上的大型狗隻必須以長度不超逾兩米的狗帶穩妥牽引。違例可被判罰款及監禁。
